definitions.explanation: An organized session where participants learn a specific skill or body of knowledge, typically over a short period.

examples.japanese: {講習会|こうしゅうかい}に{参加|さんか}する。
examples.english: To participate in a training course.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}、{防災|ぼうさい}{講習会|こうしゅうかい}が{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: A disaster preparedness workshop will be held next month.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}が{費用|ひよう}を{出|だ}してくれるので、{安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}の{講習会|こうしゅうかい}を{受|う}けてきた。
examples.english: Since the company covered the cost, I attended a safety management training course.

notes:
A compound of {講習|こうしゅう} (training, instruction) + {会|かい} (gathering, meeting). Refers to organized training events that are typically shorter than full courses — often one day or a few sessions. Common in workplace training, community education, and certification programs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {講習会|こうしゅうかい}を{開|ひら}く: to hold a workshop
- {講習会|こうしゅうかい}を{受|う}ける: to attend a training course
- {講習会|こうしゅうかい}に{申|もう}し{込|こ}む: to apply for a workshop
- {安全|あんぜん}{講習会|こうしゅうかい}: safety training workshop
- {初心者|しょしんしゃ}{向|む}け{講習会|こうしゅうかい}: beginners' workshop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- セミナー: seminar — often more academic or business-oriented; sometimes implies a lecture format
- {研修|けんしゅう}: training; professional development — broader term; can refer to longer training programs
- ワークショップ: workshop — loanword increasingly used, especially for creative or hands-on sessions
- {勉強会|べんきょうかい}: study group — more informal; often self-organized among peers
